title: Independent review: technical report v3 (obstruction map rounds 11-19)
question: Are all numbers, obstacles and evidence labels of the v3 obstruction map faithful to the ledger, with no overclaim?
claims: 437 numbers matched to cited HYP records by script (16 unmatched are tokenizer artefacts, checked by hand); all 17 HYP claims read against the paper line by line, no mismatch; 24 spot checks against raw analysis outputs passed (D, F, I, G, A, B). Blocking: (1) conclusion wrongly said all sub-1/2 exponents were traced to setup or online exponents (B1 0.437/0.451, C 0.465/0.482 were not); (2) abstract omitted the reviewed E0/E3 exception. Non-blocking: "above rho" should be "at or above" for Family 2; Tak23 author renders spurious "others"; B fits include setup (bias plausible), C excludes table setup by protocol (pure power-law fits).
next_action: PI applied both blocking and the listed non-blocking fixes; rebuilt (20 pages, 0 undefined references).
notes: Reviewer model self-reported Claude Sonnet 5.5 (configured); same provider as drafting worker, so independence partial. PDF not rebuilt by reviewer; Lean and earlier sections not re-reviewed.

review.rationale: No ledger mismatch; two wording blockers in conclusion and abstract.
counterexamples: Conclusion claim contradicted by Families 3 and 6 fitted exponents 0.437, 0.451, 0.465, 0.482 not traced to setup.
review.limitations: Same-provider review; earlier sections not re-reviewed.
review.initial_packet: v3 main.tex diff vs v2; ledger HYPs; raw experiment outputs.
